// Package reconnect is a line-oriented client that survives server restarts.
package reconnect

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// retryInterval spaces attempts while the server comes back.
const retryInterval = 20 * time.Millisecond

// Client sends newline-terminated messages and waits for an "ok" reply.
type Client struct {
	addr string

	mu     sync.Mutex
	conn   net.Conn
	reader *bufio.Reader
}

// Dial connects to the server at addr.
func Dial(addr string) (*Client, error) {
	c := &Client{addr: addr}
	if err := c.connect(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c, nil
}

func (c *Client) connect() error {
	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", c.addr, ReconnectTimeout)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	c.conn, c.reader = conn, bufio.NewReader(conn)
	return nil
}

// Send delivers msg and waits for the reply, retrying until ReconnectTimeout
// elapses if the server drops the connection.
func (c *Client) Send(msg string) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(ReconnectTimeout)
	for {
		err := c.attempt(msg)
		if err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return fmt.Errorf("reconnect did not complete within %s: %w", ReconnectTimeout, err)
		}
		time.Sleep(retryInterval)
	}
}

func (c *Client) attempt(msg string) error {
	if c.conn == nil {
		if err := c.connect(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := c.conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(ReconnectTimeout)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(c.conn, "%s\n", msg); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	reply, err := c.reader.ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reply) != "ok" {
		return fmt.Errorf("unexpected reply %q", reply)
	}
	return nil
}

// Close releases the connection.
func (c *Client) Close() error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	err := c.conn.Close()
	c.conn, c.reader = nil, nil
	return err
}
